transports:1:8.note: sender pads with 0; receiver ignores nonzero padding (client and bench CORE-HID-PADDING)

transports:1:9.note: a declared report ID starts every report both ways, count after it; another ID is dropped (client; bench CORE-HID-REPORT-ID)

transports:1:11.note: count over report capacity: report dropped, input dropped until 200 ms quiet (bench model and client, fixed)

transports:1:12.text: - **COBS のフレーム**: message の後ろに CRC-16/CC
transports:1:12.note: CRC-16/CCITT-FALSE LE, standard COBS, 0x00 both sides, no empty block after 254, both decoded, empty frames skipped

transports:1:13.text: - **host の受け方（COBS）**: 口を開いた直後から最初の 0x00
transports:1:13.note: host COBS: the span from open to the first 0x00 is a candidate; bad candidates and other-corr results discarded

transports:1:14.text: - **USB の束ね方**（vendor bulk）: host は、書き込み
transports:1:14.note: host ZLP after a write that is a multiple of wMaxPacketSize (both backends, fixed for 64-byte FS); probe ZLP / short last packet

transports:1:15.note: over max_frame: dropped with input until a gap, no answer (serial/bulk/HID); TCP closes

transports:1:16.text: - どのフレームを使うかは経路の種類だけで決まる（VID:PID で選ばない）。

transports:1:17.text: - **TCP は、信頼できるローカルの接続か、認証したトンネルの内側でだけ使う
transports:1:17.note: the bench's TCP listens on 127.0.0.1 by default; several hosts share one probe's one lock/session

transports:1:18.text: - **OEP の要求に自分で答える端点は probe である**。何が運び、後
transports:1:18.note: virtual_bench_serve answers OEP itself over TCP, so it is a probe: core and transport probe rules pass on it

transports:1:19.text: - **broker が OEP の要求へ自分で答える場合**は、独立した OE
transports:1:19.note: the self-answering TCP endpoint implements discovery, transport declaration, sessions, resend, resource lifetime in full

transports:1:20.text: - **brokerが使う下流のprobe/target側の接続が失われた場合*
transports:1:20.note: lost downstream line invalidates its resources (no_resource); a regenerated endpoint has a new boot_id; client close ends nothing

transports:1:21.text: - **TCP の経路**: TCP で待ち受ける probe は、待ち受けの
transports:1:21.note: one listener = one describe entry (kind 6, 0xFF) named by every connection's confirm; per-connection rules (revision in use, window / max_inflight credits, notifications); connection limit

transports:2:1.text: - 同じ経路では、受け取る完全な message の順序を送った順序に保つ。分割
transports:2:1.note: answers in request order on one transport; after a reopen only the unresolved request goes again, nothing carried over

transports:2:2.text: - フレームは、何回の書き込み、USB の転送、HID の report、TCP
transports:2:2.note: frames split or coalesced over writes/transfers/reports/segments are read alike (bench CORE-*-SPLIT/COALESCE; client)

transports:2:3.text: - 送る側（host も probe も）は、TCP を除き、1 つのフレームの
transports:2:3.note: host writes each frame batch in one write; bench sends whole frames

transports:2:4.text: - シリアルの口、vendor bulk、HID では、フレームの途中で 200
transports:2:4.note: 200 ms gap restarts the reader on serial/bulk/HID; TCP reads on (bench CORE-TCP-PARTIAL-GAP, client)

transports:3:9.note: vendor bulk by class 0xFF/0x4F/0x45 only; HID by usage page 0xFF4F usage 0x45 only (client fixed); a probe offers at most one vendor bulk and one HID (bench fixed: add_transport / the USB model refuse a second)

transports:3:15.note: serial ports opened exclusively (TIOCEXCL, flock): a second open is PortBusy; HID: flock on the hidraw node (client fixed), a second open is HidBusy
